common.Control.new: needs project management: the studio serves the one project directory it was launched on (`eda board serve -C dir`) and has no verb to create a new project or document, so there is nothing for New to start
common.Control.open: needs project management: the studio serves one project directory chosen at launch and has no verb to open or switch to another project
common.Control.toggleGridOverrides: needs per-item-type grid overrides (the Grids page's Grid Overrides section -- connected items, wires, vias, text and graphics each get a grid of their own, which the studio's Edit Grids dialog does not have -- and the category-aware snapping in the move, drag and route tools that reads them); the studio snaps every item to the one grid, so the toggle would switch off nothing. (Ctrl+Shift+G stays bound to Ungroup here; KiCad binds it to this action and leaves Ungroup unbound)
common.API.pluginsReload: needs a plugin system: the studio has no Python scripting or API plugins (`pcbnew.ScriptingTool.*` is recorded for the same reason), so there are no plugins to reload and no plugin menus to refresh
common.Control.quit: a web page has no application to quit: closing the tab ends the session, the server (`eda board serve`) keeps running and every edit is already in design.json
common.Control.showProjectManager: needs the KiCad project manager: the studio is one window on the one project directory it was launched on (`eda board serve -C dir`), with no project manager frame to switch to (GAPS.md: project management)
common.Control.revert: every edit is written to design.json when it is made (why Save only reports), so a document never holds unsaved changes to discard -- KiCad enables Revert only for a modified document, and here Undo (the shared history) is what steps back through edits
common.Control.showCalculatorTools: the calculators are a separate program (KiCad starts pcb_calculator with `Execute( PCB_CALCULATOR_EXE )`); the studio has no calculator and, in a browser, no program to start
common.Control.undoZoom: ACTIONS::zoomUndo is the simulator plot's zoom history (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::UndoZoom over the mathplot zoom stack); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last) and the canvases keep no zoom history
common.Control.redoZoom: ACTIONS::zoomRedo is the simulator plot's zoom history (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::RedoZoom); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last) and the canvases keep no zoom history
common.Control.zoomInHorizontally: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)
common.Control.zoomOutHorizontally: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)
common.Control.zoomInVertically: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)
common.Control.zoomOutVertically: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)

common.Control.addLibrary: needs library tables (GAPS.md item 5, WP6): it adds a library file to the symbol or footprint library table, and the studio has no table -- its libraries are the project library in design.json plus the read-only library roots the server reads
common.Control.newLibrary: needs library tables (GAPS.md item 5, WP6): it creates a library file and registers it in the symbol or footprint library table, and the studio has no table to register it in
common.Control.ddaddLibrary: needs library tables (GAPS.md item 5, WP6): a library file dropped on the window is added to the library table (ACTIONS::ddaddLibrary), and the studio has no table
common.Control.openDirectory: opens the library's folder in the operating system's file manager (`canOpenExternally`); the studio's libraries are entries of design.json and read-only library roots on the server, and a web page cannot open a file manager
common.Control.openWithTextEditor: opens the library file in the configured text editor (`canOpenExternally`); the studio's libraries are entries of design.json and read-only library roots on the server, and a web page cannot start an editor
common.SuiteControl.showSymbolLibTable: needs library tables (GAPS.md item 5, WP6): the dialog edits the symbol library table, which the studio does not have
common.SuiteControl.showFootprintLibTabl: needs library tables (GAPS.md item 5, WP6): the dialog edits the footprint library table, which the studio does not have
common.SuiteControl.showDesignBLockLibTa: needs a design-block library (GAPS.md item 24): the dialog edits the design block library table, and the studio has no design blocks
common.SuiteControl.configurePaths: needs library tables and 3D model search paths (GAPS.md item 5, WP6): the dialog edits the environment variables the library tables and 3D model paths are written with (KICAD_SYMBOL_DIR, KICAD_3DMODEL_DIR, ...); the studio reads its library roots from `EDA_KICAD_SYMBOLS` / `EDA_KICAD_FOOTPRINTS` on the server
common.Embed.embededFile: needs embedded files: KiCad stores them zstd-compressed and base64-encoded with a SHA-256 checksum in the .kicad_pcb / .kicad_mod, the design IR has no embedded-file list, and without a zstd implementation (no new dependencies) a file embedded here could not be read back from a KiCad file
common.Embed.removeFile: needs embedded files: see common.Embed.embededFile; the design IR holds no embedded files to remove
common.Embed.extractFile: needs embedded files: see common.Embed.embededFile; the design IR holds no embedded files to extract
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeImportedG: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer; none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.applyDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so no group can be linked to a block layout
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.barcode: needs barcode items (PCB_BARCODE: a barcode or QR code generated from text); the design IR has no barcode item or encoder and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.ddImportGraphi: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer (this is Import Graphics reached by dropping a file on the canvas); none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.drawTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeCharacter: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board characteristics as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeLinkedDes: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to link to a group or place
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placePoint: needs point items (PCB_POINT: reference/snap points stored on the board); the design IR has no point item and the snapping code knows no such anchor
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeReference: needs reference-image items (PCB_REFERENCE_IMAGE: a bitmap on a graphic layer, kept out of every output); the design IR has no image item
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeStackup: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board stackup as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.saveToLinkedDe: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no linked block to save a group to
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.textbox: needs text-box items (PCB_TEXTBOX: wrapped text in a bordered box); the design IR's Text is plain text with no box, border or wrapping
pcbnew.TableEditor.editTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.PadTool.explodePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.PadTool.recombinePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.Control.layerChanged: an internal notification (AF_NOTIFY) the editor posts to its own tools when the active layer changes, not a command: the studio's tools read the active layer from the store when they redraw, so there is no event to deliver or answer
pcbnew.EditorControl.angleSnapModeChange: an internal notification (AF_NOTIFY) posted after the line mode changes, whose only job is to refresh the toolbar's line-mode icon; the studio's toolbar reads the mode from the store, so there is no event to deliver or answer
pcbnew.EditorControl.trackViaSizeChanged: an internal notification (AF_NOTIFY) posted after the track or via size changes so the router and drawing tools refresh; the studio's tools read the sizes from the store when they redraw, so there is no event to deliver or answer
pcbnew.Control.hideDynamicRatsnest: an internal event the move tool posts when a drag ends (HideLocalRatsnest); the studio's move preview computes its dynamic ratsnest itself and drops it on commit (kicad-port/localRatsnest.ts), so nothing posts or answers it
pcbnew.Control.updateLocalRatsnest: an internal event the move tool posts on every pointer move with the drag delta (UpdateLocalRatsnest); the studio's move preview recomputes its dynamic ratsnest itself (kicad-port/localRatsnest.ts), so nothing posts or answers it
pcbnew.EditorControl.highlightItem: has no menu, toolbar or hotkey entry and nothing in pcbnew posts it: it only exists to be posted with the item to select as its parameter (a programmatic route, like cross-probing from the schematic, which in this studio is a shared selection), and an action with no item to carry has nothing to highlight
pcbnew.EditorControl.drillSetOrigin: has no menu, toolbar or hotkey entry and nothing in pcbnew posts it: it only exists to be posted with the origin point as its parameter (a programmatic route; the studio has no scripting); Drill/Place File Origin (click to place) and Reset Drill Origin are the user-facing two
pcbnew.Control.rehatchShapes: needs hatched shape fills (FILL_T::HATCH, REVERSE_HATCH, CROSS_HATCH) whose hatch lines are rebuilt; the design IR's graphic shapes are solid or unfilled (`filled: bool`), so there are no hatch lines to rebuild
pcbnew.Control.netColorMode: needs per-net and per-net-class colours (the Appearance panel's Nets tab colour swatches); the studio assigns none, so the three modes (net colours on everything, on the ratsnest only, off) would switch nothing
pcbnew.Control.fpAutoZoom: needs the Footprint Viewer window (FOOTPRINT_VIEWER_FRAME), the only place this toggle (automatic zoom when the footprint changes) acts; the studio has the Footprint Editor tab but no separate viewer
pcbnew.Control.nextFootprint: needs the Footprint Viewer window (FOOTPRINT_VIEWER_FRAME), the only place it acts (it steps through the viewer's footprint list); the studio has the Footprint Editor tab but no separate viewer
pcbnew.Control.previousFootprint: needs the Footprint Viewer window (FOOTPRINT_VIEWER_FRAME), the only place it acts (it steps through the viewer's footprint list); the studio has the Footprint Editor tab but no separate viewer
pcbnew.Control.ddImportFootprint: a drag-and-drop event for the Footprint Editor that carries the dropped file's path (FOOTPRINT_EDIT_FRAME::ImportFootprint); the studio's footprint library has no import of .kicad_mod files for it to call (pcbnew.ModuleEditor.importFootprint is recorded missing too), and a browser drop carries the file's contents, not a path
pcbnew.Control.DdAppendBoard: needs footprints that have no part in the intent-derived constraint model: a footprint on this board is its part's placement (its reference keys into the model's parts, which no verb extends), so another board's footprints and nets have nothing to attach to; same reason as Append Board
pcbnew.EditorControl.appendBoard: needs footprints that have no part in the intent-derived constraint model: a footprint on this board is its part's placement (its reference keys into the model's parts, which no verb extends), so another board's footprints, nets and net classes have nothing to attach to; same limit as Place Design Block
pcbnew.EditorControl.collect3DModels: needs embedded files (the 3D models stored inside the board); the design IR has no embedded-files section and the KiCad exporter writes none, so there is nowhere to put the collected models
pcbnew.EditorControl.importNetlist: needs a netlist importer that can add parts and nets: the board's parts and nets come from the intent and the schematic (Update PCB from Schematic is the one way they change), and no verb adds a part or net to the intent-derived constraint model for a netlist read from a file
pcbnew.EditorControl.openNonKicadBoard: needs project management: it replaces the open board with an imported one (kicad-cli pcb import could convert the file), but the studio serves the one project directory it was launched on and has no verb to open or switch to another; same reason as Open
pcbnew.EditorControl.rescueAutosave: needs autosave files: every edit is written to design.json at once and kept in .history, so there is no separate rescue file to restore from
pcbnew.EditorControl.exportSpecctraDSN: needs the Specctra DSN/SES interchange (SPECCTRA_DB); kicad-cli has no DSN or SES command, and the studio's autorouter (crates/freeroute) reads and writes design.json directly, with no DSN round-trip
pcbnew.EditorControl.importSpecctraSessi: needs the Specctra DSN/SES interchange (SPECCTRA_DB); kicad-cli has no DSN or SES command, and the studio's autorouter (crates/freeroute) reads and writes design.json directly, with no DSN round-trip
pcbnew.EditorControl.exportIDF: needs an IDF exporter; kicad-cli (10.99) has no IDF export, and writing one here would be a second exporter next to kicad-cli (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.EditorControl.exportHyperlynx: needs a Hyperlynx exporter; kicad-cli (10.99) has no Hyperlynx export, and writing one here would be a second exporter next to kicad-cli (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.EditorControl.generateReportFile: needs a footprint-report (.rpt) exporter; kicad-cli (10.99) has no such export, and writing one here would be a second exporter next to kicad-cli (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.EditorControl.findByProperties: needs the property manager: the dialog lists the named, typed properties PROPERTY_MANAGER keeps for the selected item types and turns the ticked ones (or a typed query) into a PCBEXPR search over every board item; the studio's property dialogs are written one per item type with no registry to list, and its PCBEXPR evaluator (eda_drc::pcbexpr) reads only Type, NetClass, NetName and Reference for custom DRC rules, so a general search would match nothing for every other property
pcbnew.DRETool.drcRuleEditor: the rule editor is a rule-tree designer with a panel per constraint type that writes the .kicad_dru; Board Setup > Custom Rules edits that file as text (with a syntax check by kicad-cli), the designer is not ported
pcbnew.InspectionTool.InspectClearance: needs the DRC engine's rule resolver (DRC_ENGINE::EvalRules), which answers which clearance applies between two items and why; kicad-cli only reports violations and has no such query, and the studio carries no rule engine of its own to ask (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.InspectionTool.InspectConstraints: needs the DRC engine's rule resolver (DRC_ENGINE::EvalRules), which answers which constraints apply to an item and why; kicad-cli only reports violations and has no such query, and the studio carries no rule engine of its own to ask (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.InspectionTool.DiffFootprint: needs a library-parity check: its report is FOOTPRINT::FootprintNeedsUpdate, the DRC test behind the 'footprint differs from its library copy' violation (drc_test_provider_library_parity.cpp), and DRC only runs through kicad-cli (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate it), which reports the violation but has no per-footprint diff; the visual diff also needs a placed footprint that is its own copy of the library original, while a placed footprint here is the named footprint itself
pcbnew.Multichannel.generatePlacementRul: needs placement rule areas and component classes (MULTICHANNEL_TOOL builds a rule area per channel from hierarchical sheets or component classes, and matches footprints between them); the zone IR has keepout rule areas only, there are no component classes, and a placed footprint carries no sheet path
pcbnew.Multichannel.repeatLayout: needs placement rule areas and component classes (MULTICHANNEL_TOOL clones one channel's placement and routing into the others by matching the footprints of two rule areas); the zone IR has keepout rule areas only, there are no component classes, and a placed footprint carries no sheet path
pcbnew.ReannotateTool.ShowReannotateDial: needs a verb that renames a footprint: its reference is the key that ties it to its part in the intent-derived constraint model and to its schematic symbol, and nothing renames it on the board (Cmd::RenameSymbol itself leaves the footprint behind), so a geographical re-annotation has nothing it could write
pcbnew.ScriptingTool.pluginsShowFolder: needs a plugin system: the studio has no Python scripting or action plugins, so there is no plugin folder to reveal (and a web page cannot open a Finder window)
pcbnew.FpWizard.showWizards: needs the Footprint Wizard: a separate window that runs the Python wizard scripts (pcbnew/python/wizards) and shows their parameter pages; the studio has no Python scripting, so there are no wizards to select
pcbnew.FpWizard.resetWizardPrms: needs the Footprint Wizard: a separate window that runs the Python wizard scripts (pcbnew/python/wizards) and shows their parameter pages; the studio has no Python scripting, so there are no wizard parameters to reset
pcbnew.FpWizard.exportFpToEditor: needs the Footprint Wizard: a separate window that runs the Python wizard scripts (pcbnew/python/wizards) and shows their parameter pages; the studio has no Python scripting, so there is no generated footprint to export

needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks) and its panel; this studio has no block library or block IR
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createGap: needs a free board footprint: the tool builds a footprint of its own (createBaseFootprint: two rectangular pads, no schematic part) and drops it on the board with doInteractiveItemPlacement, but every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createStub: needs a free board footprint: the tool builds a footprint of its own (createBaseFootprint: two rectangular pads, no schematic part) and drops it on the board with doInteractiveItemPlacement, but every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createStubArc: needs a free board footprint (every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one) and a custom-shape pad: the arc stub is one PAD_SHAPE::CUSTOM pad with a polygon primitive, and the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createFunctionShape: needs a free board footprint (every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one) and a custom-shape pad: createPolygonShape reads a shape-description file into one PAD_SHAPE::CUSTOM pad, and the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createLine: needs a free board footprint (every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one) and the microwave inductor generator (microwave_inductor.cpp: the S/L meander built from arcs and segments, with its pattern dialog), which nothing here implements
pcbnew.ModuleEditor.createFootprint: needs the footprint wizards, which are Python scripts (FOOTPRINT_WIZARD_FRAME running pcbnew.FootprintWizardBase generators); the studio embeds no Python interpreter
pcbnew.ModuleEditor.checkFootprint: the Footprint Checker is a DRC run (DIALOG_FOOTPRINT_CHECKER over FOOTPRINT_CHECKER); DRC only runs through kicad-cli, which has no footprint-only check, and no DRC engine may be written here -- the board DRC reports the same problems for a placed footprint
pcbnew.Autoplacer.autoplaceOffboard: needs a second placement engine: KiCad's autoplacer (AR_AUTOPLACER, a routing-matrix cost search of about two thousand lines with its own cell and matrix model) is not part of this studio, whose placement is driven through `eda board` and judged by the placement gates, so footprints are not auto-placed behind those gates
pcbnew.Autoplacer.autoplaceSelected: needs a second placement engine: KiCad's autoplacer (AR_AUTOPLACER, a routing-matrix cost search of about two thousand lines with its own cell and matrix model) is not part of this studio, whose placement is driven through `eda board` and judged by the placement gates, so footprints are not auto-placed behind those gates
pcbnew.Generator.genCacnelEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to cancel
pcbnew.Generator.genFinishEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to finish
pcbnew.Generator.genRemove: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator to remove
pcbnew.Generator.genStartEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator to start editing
pcbnew.Generator.genUpdateEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to update
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateAll: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is nothing to rebuild
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateAllTuning: needs tuning-pattern generator items (PCB_TUNING_PATTERN); the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks and keeps no pattern to re-tune within its bounds
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateSelected: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is nothing to rebuild
pcbnew.Generator.showManager: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so the Generators Manager would have nothing to list
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.changeFootprint: needs a per-instance footprint assignment: a placed footprint's library footprint comes from the frozen component intent, and the design IR's `FootprintInstance` holds only position, rotation, side and label side, so there is nothing an exchange could change (Edit Symbol Fields changes only the schematic symbol's Footprint field, which the board does not read)
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.changeFootprints: needs a per-instance footprint assignment: a placed footprint's library footprint comes from the frozen component intent, and the design IR's `FootprintInstance` holds only position, rotation, side and label side, so there is nothing an exchange could change (Edit Symbol Fields changes only the schematic symbol's Footprint field, which the board does not read)
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.migrate3DModels: needs the KiCad 3D model libraries on disk to scan for STEP replacements of VRML models (the dialog matches model names by edit distance against `${KICAD9_3DMODEL_DIR}`); the studio's footprints carry only a model path string and its 3D view draws procedural bodies, so there is no model file to look up or substitute
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.removeUnusedPads: needs per-layer pad copper (a padstack): the dialog strips the copper of through-hole pads and vias on inner layers that nothing connects to, while the design IR models a through-hole pad as copper on every layer, with nothing to take one layer away from
pcbnew.InteractiveEdit.swapGateNets: needs per-pad net overrides: pads are not selectable items and a pad's net comes from the schematic, while design.json stores no net per pad, so a net swapped on the board would have no place to live (the same change is made on the schematic by swapping the pins' connections)
pcbnew.InteractiveEdit.swapPadNets: needs per-pad net overrides: pads are not selectable items and a pad's net comes from the schematic, while design.json stores no net per pad, so a net swapped on the board would have no place to live (the same change is made on the schematic by swapping the pins' connections)
pcbnew.Picker.selectItemInteractively: an internal sub-tool with no menu entry or hotkey: KiCad runs it only when a dialog hands it a receiver (`RunAction( selectItemInteractively, params )`), bare it does nothing; the studio's dialogs call its port directly (actions/pcbPicker.ts: `pickItem`) from the Select Point / Select Item buttons of Position Relative and Create Array
pcbnew.Picker.selectPointInteractively: an internal sub-tool with no menu entry or hotkey: KiCad runs it only when a dialog hands it a receiver (`RunAction( selectPointInteractively, params )`), bare it does nothing; the studio's dialogs call its port directly (actions/pcbPicker.ts: `pickPoint`) from the Select Point / Select Item buttons of Position Relative and Create Array
eeschema.EditorControl.importGraphics: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer; none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
eeschema.SymbolDrawing.drawSymbolTextBox: needs text boxes (SCH_TEXTBOX with a border and fill, wrapped text); the library symbol IR has no text box graphic -- only rectangle, polyline, circle, arc and text
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.deriveFrom: needs derived symbols (a symbol that `extends` a parent and inherits its drawing and pins); the library symbol IR has no inheritance, so a derived symbol would have nothing to refer to
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.flattenSym: needs derived symbols: KiCad offers it only for a symbol that extends another (derivedSymbolSelectedCondition) and the library symbol IR has no inheritance (a derived symbol read from a file is flattened on import)
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.updateSymb: needs derived symbols: it re-syncs a symbol with its parent and KiCad itself only answers 'Symbol is not derived from another symbol.' for any other; the library symbol IR has no inheritance, and a handler that always says so would stand in for the missing subsystem
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.showRelate: needs derived symbols: it is offered only for a symbol that extends another or has children (relatedSymbolSelectedCondition), and the library symbol IR has no inheritance
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.showHidden: needs symbol fields on the canvas: the library symbol model keeps no field positions or visibility and the editor draws no fields, so there are no hidden fields to show
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.nextSymbol: belongs to the Symbol Viewer frame (toolbars_symbol_viewer.cpp: a read-only library browser with its own symbol list); the studio has no Symbol Viewer -- the editor's library tree is where symbols are browsed
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.previousSy: belongs to the Symbol Viewer frame (toolbars_symbol_viewer.cpp: a read-only library browser with its own symbol list); the studio has no Symbol Viewer -- the editor's library tree is where symbols are browsed
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.placeDesignB: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR

eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.placeLinkedD: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks) and the link from a group to its block; this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no linked block to place
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.saveToLinked: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks) and the link from a group to its block; this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to save the selection into
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.drawSheetFro: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to copy in as a sheet

needs the sheet-file import behind Import Sheet (this is the action it posts once a file is chosen): copy another schematic file into the project as a new sheet screen. Draw Sheet itself works (an empty sheet, or one that shares an existing sheet's screen)
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.importSheet: needs a file chooser and a sheet-file importer: the one reader there is (`import_kicad_sch`) builds a whole design, not a sheet of this one, and no verb merges the imported parts, nets and wires under this design's references and nets
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.drawTable: needs table items (SCH_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.placeImage: needs bitmap items (SCH_BITMAP: an embedded PNG/JPEG with a scale) and a file chooser; the design IR has no image type, only vector shapes, text boxes and directive labels
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.swapPinLabels: needs pin selection: the schematic canvas selects whole symbols, wires, labels and the like but never a single symbol pin (SCH_PIN_T), and the action swaps the net labels of the selected pins in selection order
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.swapPins: needs pin selection (the schematic canvas never selects a single symbol pin) and per-instance pin geometry: KiCad swaps the pins' positions in the symbol's own copy of its library pins, while a placed symbol here always reads its pins from the library symbol
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.toggleDeMorgan: needs per-symbol body styles: the engine symbol (SymbolGraphic / LibPin) has no body-style field and LibrarySymbol::to_engine_symbol drops the alternate style's items, so a placed symbol cannot show another style (web/studio/PARITY-symedit.md, Known gaps)
eeschema.InteractiveSelection.SyncSelect: an internal action with no label, hotkey or menu entry that KiCad never runs as an action (cross-probing and the symbol fields table call SCH_SELECTION_TOOL::SyncSelection directly), so there is nothing a user could invoke
eeschema.EditorControl.ddAddImage: a drag-and-drop handler with no menu entry (`SCH_EDITOR_CONTROL::DdAddImage`: an image file dropped on the sheet becomes a bitmap item); the design IR has no bitmap item (only vector shapes, text boxes and directive labels) and the canvas has no file drop target
eeschema.EditorControl.ddAppendFile: a drag-and-drop handler with no menu entry (`DdAppendFile`: a schematic file dropped on the sheet is appended to it); that is the sheet-file merge Import Sheet needs, which does not exist (the one reader builds a whole design, not a sheet of this one), and the canvas has no file drop target
eeschema.EditorControl.ddImportGraphics: a drag-and-drop handler with no menu entry (`DdImportGraphics`: a DXF or SVG file dropped on the sheet is imported as graphics); it needs the graphics importer behind Import Graphics, which does not exist (no new dependencies are allowed), and the canvas has no file drop target
eeschema.EditorControl.importNonKicadSch: needs importers for other EDA formats (Eagle, CADSTAR, EasyEDA, gEDA, ...: KiCad's `SCH_IO` plugins); the studio reads KiCad schematics only (`eda import-kicad`) and no new dependencies are allowed
eeschema.EditorControl.remapSymbols: needs legacy symbol libraries (`.lib` / `.dcm` files) to remap old library references from; the studio has none -- its symbols link by `Library:Name` ids, which Bulk Edit Symbol Library Links already edits
eeschema.EditorControl.rescueSymbols: needs the symbol cache a schematic keeps next to its libraries, to rescue a symbol whose library copy has changed; the studio keeps no cache of its own, a placed symbol is resolved from the libraries or the project library on every load, so there is nothing to rescue
eeschema.RemoteSymbols.showPanel: needs KiCad's remote symbol providers (online part libraries reached through the user's account); no such service is reachable from here and nothing may be downloaded
eeschema.EditorControl.generateBOMExtern: an action KiCad defines (sch_actions.cpp) but binds to nothing: no tool's `setTransitions` handles it and no menu offers it, so there is no behavior to port
eeschema.EditorControl.addVariant: needs design variants: per-variant overrides of the DNP, exclude-from-BOM, exclude-from-board and exclude-from-simulation flags and of the fields (`SCH_SYMBOL` variants, `SCHEMATIC::SetCurrentVariant`), which the design IR does not model
eeschema.EditorControl.removeVariant: needs design variants: per-variant overrides of the DNP, exclude-from-BOM, exclude-from-board and exclude-from-simulation flags and of the fields (`SCH_SYMBOL` variants, `SCHEMATIC::SetCurrentVariant`), which the design IR does not model
eeschema.EditorControl.editVariantDescri: needs design variants: per-variant overrides of the DNP, exclude-from-BOM, exclude-from-board and exclude-from-simulation flags and of the fields (`SCH_SYMBOL` variants, `SCHEMATIC::SetCurrentVariant`), which the design IR does not model
eeschema.EditorControl.showHiddenFields: needs symbol fields on the canvas: the schematic IR keeps no field positions or visibility (reference and value are drawn at fixed offsets and no field is hidden), so there are no hidden fields to show
eeschema.EditorControl.togglePinAltIcons: needs pin alternate functions: the library symbol IR has no `(alternate ...)` pin definitions, so no pin has an alternate-function icon to show
eeschema.EditorControl.annotateAutomatic: the studio numbers a symbol with the next free number of its prefix the moment it is placed (a real reference, never a `U?` placeholder), so a symbol is never unannotated and there is no automatic-annotation switch to turn on or off
eeschema.EditorControl.restartMove: an internal action with no label, hotkey or menu entry: the selection and move tools post it to each other to restart a move after the selection changed, nothing a user could invoke
eeschema.EditorControl.updateNetHighligh: an internal action with no label, hotkey or menu entry (`SCH_EDITOR_CONTROL::UpdateNetHighlighting` recomputes the highlight after the connectivity changed); the studio's highlight is a net name that repaints with every edit, so nothing has to be recomputed
